headline: Is a 6 personal year good for marriage?
line: The tradition reads it as the year of the cycle most associated with marriage, moving in together, children and buying a home, because the 6 is the number of commitment.
title: Is a 6 personal year good for marriage?
description: The tradition reads it as the year of the cycle most associated with marriage, moving in together, children and buying a home, because the 6 is the number of commitment. headline: Does a personal year 9 mean a relationship will end?
line: No. The tradition reads a 9 year as the year things that have already run their course come to a close, and reads relationships that are alive as being tested by nostalgia rather than ended.
title: Does a personal year 9 mean a relationship will end?
description: No. The tradition reads a 9 year as the year things that have already run their course come to a close, and reads relationships that are alive as being tested by nostalgia rather than ended. A relationship that ends in a 9 year is read as having ended earlier and been named in the 9. It is a description, not a prediction.
